name: Mags Solinska
headline: Oracle - Director Customer Success Services Situation Management EMEA
about:
Strong IT professional (+25 years), technical knowledge, customer management, strategic thinking and vision. Proven experience working globally, managing geographically distributed customers, and cloud at customer implementations in EMEA. Part of global deployment team for Cloud at Customer (+3 years) as EMEA Customer Services Leader. Successfully managed and delivered over 200+ Cloud at Customer Gen 1 implementations in EMEA, as Global TAM Coordinator and Project Manager role for EMEA.
Part of Cloud at Customer EMEA X-LOB Team working closely with Cloud Systems Sales Consulting and Business Development with the purpose of direct and bi-directional communication, enabling a collaborative exchange of information among and between LOBs.
Nominated to Cloud at Customer EMEA Champions as Customer Success Services Lead to cooperate with Cloud Systems Sales Consulting team. Actively developing Oracle hybrid cloud tailored made services in close cooperation with Cloud Systems Sales Consulting. As Cloud at Customer Leader, I’m SPOC for EMEA in terms of ACS services for ExaCC. As C@C EMEA TAM Lead developed set of workshops, trainings and knowledge confluence pages. Prior to Cloud, I managed Engineered System deployments and migration projects, with strong pre-sales skills in terms of architecture solution, in particular MAA.
In Oracle Consulting I delivered OC services as Oracle DBA for customers in Banking Sector.
In UK I worked for Information Management company as IM Consultant, mainly administration of applications based on Oracle Database, also as Oracle DBA responsible for Data Management (scripting in SQLPlus, migrations, modelling, data loading).
